name: mounts & vehicles
lore:
To tame the wild is to master the horizon. A mount is more than a beast of burden; it is a partner in the dance of survival. From the sturdy draft horses of the Lowlands to the sure-footed mountain goats of the Crags, each creature possesses a spirit shaped by its habitat. 

A well-bred warhorse is a bastion of loyalty, its rhythmic gallop a heartbeat against the earth. Yet, an adventurer must remember: a beast remains a beast. They scent fear and exhaustion long before you feel it. Whether harnessed to a creaking merchant’s wagon or cutting through the brine upon a galleon’s timber hull, these vessels—be they flesh or wood—require your respect. Neglect their needs, and the road becomes your enemy. Tend to their instincts and their upkeep, and the vast world shrinks beneath your feet.
